nonIndexablePagesDetail: Pages that exist in dist but are deliberately absent from site-urls.txt and the sitemap: 22 x 404 (root + 21 non-English locales) + 1 Netlify forms placeholder (/__forms). Invariant checked in verify-baseline: htmlTotal - site-urls.txt lines === this number. Update it deliberately, with a reason, when the set changes (e.g. English-only posts add 21 fallback shims each, which do stay out of the list).
updateReason: Adds the missing translations for the six Sourcing posts (how-to-vet-ipl-device-manufacturer, ipl-device-manufacturer-price, ipl-device-moq-explained, ipl-device-sourcing-guide, remote-factory-audit-ipl-device, switching-ipl-manufacturers) in all 21 non-English locales, 6 posts x 21 locales = 126 files. Each locale goes 70 -> 77 (+6 real pages plus the hub page that previously existed only as an English page), en 76 -> 77, htmlTotal 3285 -> 3433. Before this, the 21 locales emitted meta-refresh shims for those six slugs; flatten-html deleted the shims and generate-sitemap refused to list them because their canonical still pointed at /blog/<slug>, which is what stopped every build after the Sourcing cluster merged. With real translations the canonical resolves to the locale URL, the sitemap guard reports 0 mismatches, and the 126 URLs enter the sitemaps for the first time. No other page count changed.
